name: handler_newline
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as a New Line (Text) in the Terminal

origin.description: Report progress by writing a symbol, by default a newline, to a connection.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.text: The text written for each reported step. The default is a newline.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A connection. The default is stderr().

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.debug, or 0.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

origin.details: initiate, update, and finish each write the symbol, including a zero amount. interrupt writes a blank line, the condition message, and a blank line. hide and unhide do nothing.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile("nl")
con <- file(path, open = "wt")
handler <- handler_newline(symbol = "|", file = con, enable = TRUE)
with_progress({
  p <- progressor(steps = 2, on_exit = FALSE)
  p(message = "a")
  p(message = "b")
}, handlers = handler, enable = TRUE, interval = 0, delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
close(con)
cat("handler_newline wrote ", nchar(readChar(path, 100, useBytes = TRUE)), " bars.\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Report progress by writing a symbol, by default a newline, to a text stream.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.text: The text written for each reported step. The default is a newline.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A text stream with write(). The default is sys.stderr. A path string is opened and truncated on each write.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.debug, or 0.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

arguments.name: extra
arguments.text: Further arguments passed to make_progression_handler(), including enable.

translation.details: initiate, update, and finish each write the symbol, including a zero amount. interrupt writes a blank line, the condition message, and a blank line. hide and unhide do nothing.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile

from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.progressor import progressor
from progressr.reporters import handler_newline

path = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "newline.txt")
handle = open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
handler = handler_newline(symbol="|", file=handle, enable=True)

def body():
    progress = progressor(steps=2, on_exit=False)
    progress(message="a")
    progress(message="b")

with_progress(body, handlers=handler, enable=True, interval=0, delay_terminal=False, delay_stdout=False, delay_conditions=())
handle.close()
print(f"handler_newline wrote {len(open(path, encoding='utf-8').read())} bars.")
